channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: BAM strengthens national squad with three new coaching appointments
item.description: BAM appoints Harry Hartono, Yeoh Kay Bin and Mohd Zakry Abdul Latif as new national coaches to boost player development and performance.

item.title: Malay reserve land area in Peninsular Malaysia grows to 4.95 million hectares
item.description: The total area of Malay reserve land in Peninsular Malaysia increased to 4.95 million hectares in 2024, with Kelantan having the largest portion. KUALA LUMPUR: The total area of Malay reserve land (MRL) in Peninsular Malaysia increased to 4.95 million hectares in 2024. This marks a net increase of 135,063.46 hectares from the 4.82 million […]

item.title: Herry eyes Aaron-Wooi Yik vs Korean showdown in All England final
item.description: National coach Herry hopes for an All England final rematch between Aaron-Wooi Yik and world No. 1 Koreans, citing Malaysia Open performance.

item.title: Environment Department top officials remanded in e-waste corruption probe
item.description: The Environment Department DG and deputy DG are among four individuals remanded by MACC in a corruption investigation linked to e-waste management.

item.title: Teacher testifies Zara Qairina was accused of theft before her death
item.description: A teacher told the inquest that Zara Qairina was accused by classmates of stealing money days before she was found unconscious and later died.

item.title: High tides, not reclamation, caused Batu Ferringhi erosion, says councillor
item.description: Penang exco Zairil says high tides and strong winds caused recent coastal erosion, dismissing claims that land reclamation was the primary cause.

item.title: Trump says ‘decertifying’ Canadian aircraft over Gulfstream row
item.description: Trump threatens to decertify Canadian aircraft unless Canada approves Gulfstream jets, risking major US-Canada trade and aviation disruption.

item.title: E-hailing licence fees now more flexible, says transport ministry
item.description: E-hailing vehicle owners can now renew licences from one month to one year, with fees capped, as part of new flexible MOT rules.

item.title: US Senate rejects vote to avert government shutdown
item.description: US government shutdown looms after Senate Democrats block funding vote amid clash with Trump over immigration crackdown and DHS funding

item.title: Over 1,300 sick and abandoned housing projects revived since 2023
item.description: Malaysia's task force has revived 1,399 private housing projects worth RM133.78 billion, reducing abandoned projects and aiming for zero by 2030.
